About:

Rafael Veloz reveals his proven Amazon FBA sales strategy that generated over $238,000 in revenue. In this comprehensive Amazon FBA tutorial, Rafael Veloz walks through the complete process of creating and optimizing Amazon product listings to maximize sales and conversions on Amazon Seller Central.

WHAT RAFAEL COVERS IN THIS AMAZON FBA GUIDE:

• Amazon FBA listing creation process - Step-by-step walkthrough of adding products to Amazon Seller Central catalog using individual product entry and bulk template methods

• Amazon keyword research strategies - Finding high-converting keywords using Helium 10 Magnet tool to optimize product titles, descriptions, and backend search terms for maximum Amazon search visibility

• Amazon product title optimization - Crafting keyword-rich product titles that include brand name, product type, flavor, size, and key features to improve Amazon SEO and click-through rate

• Amazon product photography requirements - Creating main images, side images, and lifestyle photos that showcase product details, colors, flavors, and usage to increase Amazon conversion rates

• Amazon bullet points and product descriptions - Writing compelling bullet points and descriptions packed with keywords, benefits, and product specifications for edible cookie dough, candy, and other products

• UPC codes and ASIN creation - Obtaining UPC codes from GS1.org and generating Amazon ASIN numbers for new product listings on Amazon marketplace

• Fulfillment by Amazon FBA setup - Configuring FBA fulfillment channel, SKU numbers, offering condition type, and shipping options in Amazon Seller Central

• Amazon listing optimization techniques - Rafael Veloz demonstrates A/B testing strategies for improving CTR click-through rate and CVR conversion rate using real case study data

• Pink Miracle shoe cleaner case study - Real Amazon FBA product example showing how listing optimization increased sessions, units sold, and overall Amazon sales performance

• Amazon PPC optimization - Analyzing Amazon Pay-Per-Click advertising data, ACOS advertising cost of sales, ROAS return on ad spend, and backend profit metrics

• Amazon product category selection - Choosing the right product type and category for chocolate chip cookie dough bites, candy products, and other Amazon FBA items

• Amazon backend search terms - Adding hidden keywords in Seller Central backend to capture additional search traffic without cluttering visible product listing content

Rafael Veloz's Amazon FBA training covers everything from initial Amazon product listing creation through advanced Amazon listing optimization for sellers using Fulfillment by Amazon. This Amazon FBA sales tutorial includes real Amazon Seller Central screenshots, Helium 10 keyword research demonstrations, and proven Amazon e-commerce strategies for increasing Amazon product visibility, improving Amazon conversion rates, and scaling Amazon FBA business revenue through data-driven Amazon listing optimization and Amazon PPC advertising management.
